dexes.name: Galar Pokedex
id_interpretation_notes: Explicit spoken ranges using 'to' were expanded, such as 4 to 6, 10 to 12, 29 to 31, 34 to 35, 42 to 43, 45 to 46, 70 to 71, 144 to 145, 161 to 162, 164 to 166, and 399 to 400.
Spoken dash-like pauses without the word 'to' were treated as separate IDs, such as 215, 222, 227, 230, 246, and 265.
The user corrected a spoken 96 to 98; only 98 is stored.
The spoken value between 119 and 144 was interpreted as 136 because the list was otherwise ascending; confirm from screenshots if needed.

combined_reported_counters.notes: These totals are arithmetic sums of the three in-game Pokedex counters. They are not labeled as unique species because regional/DLC Pokedexes can overlap.

source: User-reported live Pokemon Shield Pokedex counters and Galar caught Dex numbers
